data.title: New topic? *New chat*
data.subtitle: Usage tip 2 of 6. Don't make Claude carry old context.

blocks.text: **Start a new conversation for unrelated work**, so Claude isn't carrying extra context.

items: Long conversations use **more** of your limit
Near the context limit, Claude **summarises** earlier messages automatically
That uses more of your limit too

blocks.text: Don't paste the **whole history** across. The ten-line summary is enough.
Summarise this conversation in ten lines or fewer: what we decided, which files matter, what's still open. Write it so I can paste it into a new conversation.
**You'll get** ten lines to paste as the first message of a new conversation.

items: The earlier files no longer matter
